The ACE claimed by the Petitioner is towards undischarged liabilities on account of final/retention payments for works executed prior to the cut-off date, and the same is allowed under Regulation 25(1) (d) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations. With respect to the Combined Asset2, the Petitioner has claimed ACE beyond cut-off date on account of liability arising out of arbitration proceedings, pursuant to the Hon’ble Delhi High Court’s Order dated 3.4.2024 in Appeal No. O.M.P. (Comm.) 397/2016 and I.A. 7394/2024. Based on the said order, the Petitioner and M/s Jyoti Structures Limited settled the dispute under the “ _Vivad Se Vishwas Scheme”_ and signed a Settlement Agreement dated 14.2.2024. In terms of the aforesaid Settlement Agreement, the Petitioner paid an amount of ₹1116.57 lakh to M/s Jyoti Structures Limited. Therefore, the ACE of 1045.56 lakh claimed during the FY 2023-24 by the Petitioner on account of payment towards the settlement of the arbitration matter with respect to the Combined Asset-2, is allowed under Regulation 25(1) (a) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations.
